headline.en:

sub.zh: 将硬件画像与模型目标规则合成 llama-server 参数，给部署提供可检查的起点。
sub.en: Combine a hardware profile with model-target rules to produce inspectable starting arguments for llama-server.

caption.zh: 硬件画像 · 静态合成

body.zh: 硬件事实与模型预算在不同数据模型中。
body.en: Hardware data and model budgets have distinct models.

body.zh: ArgMatrix 暴露 offload、context、线程、KV 类型与 backend。
body.en: ArgMatrix exposes offload, context, threads, KV type and backend.

body.zh: 工具只输出启动行，不执行 llama-server。
body.en: The tool prints the launch line and never runs llama-server.

title.zh: 让参数选择的依据可见

body.zh: 不同模型与内存预算需要不同 offload、context 和线程设置。hwcfgmap 将探测结果整理成 BoxProfile，再用明确的模型权重与 KV 预算规则生成 ArgMatrix。它输出参数供操作者核对，不替你运行推理或做吞吐调优。
body.en: Models and memory budgets call for different offload, context and thread settings. hwcfgmap collects a BoxProfile and applies explicit weight and KV-budget rules to create an ArgMatrix. It prints settings for review without running inference or tuning throughput.

body.zh: 实际读取模型注册表，并将 8 核、64 GiB RAM、无 GPU 的构造输入送进真实合成函数。输出是静态估算，不是运行验证或最优参数。
body.en: The run reads the model registry and sends a constructed eight-core, 64 GiB RAM, CPU-only profile through the real synthesizer. The output is a static estimate, not a tested or optimal configuration.

alt.zh: 实际读取模型注册表，并将 8 核、64 GiB RAM、无 GPU 的构造输入送进真实合成函数。输出是静态估算，不是运行验证或最优参数。
alt.en: The run reads the model registry and sends a constructed eight-core, 64 GiB RAM, CPU-only profile through the real synthesizer. The output is a static estimate, not a tested or optimal configuration.

body.zh: probe 读取系统信息与可用的 vendor CLI——含国产卡（昇腾 npu-smi、摩尔线程 mthreads-gmi）的真实显存解析，识别不了的输出如实上报 0；modeltargets 提供代码内默认值和 YAML 覆盖；synth.Synthesize 根据 RAM、VRAM 和物理核数生成参数，RenderLaunchLine 输出命令文本。NVMe 计数只是累计读取字节，不是带宽测量。
body.en: probe reads system information and available vendor CLIs — including Ascend npu-smi and Moore Threads mthreads-gmi VRAM parsing on domestic cards, with unrecognized output honestly reported as zero. modeltargets supplies defaults and YAML overrides; synth.Synthesize derives settings from RAM, VRAM and physical cores, and RenderLaunchLine emits command text. NVMe read counters are cumulative bytes, not measured bandwidth.

alt.zh: probe 读取系统信息与可用的 vendor CLI；modeltargets 提供代码内默认值和 YAML 覆盖；synth.Synthesize 根据 RAM、VRAM 和物理核数生成参数，RenderLaunchLine 输出命令文本。NVMe 计数只是累计读取字节，不是带宽测量。
alt.en: probe reads system information and available vendor CLIs. modeltargets supplies defaults and YAML overrides; synth.Synthesize derives settings from RAM, VRAM and physical cores, and RenderLaunchLine emits command text. NVMe read counters are cumulative bytes, not measured bandwidth.

body.zh: 模型目标包括 qwen3-27b、glm-4、deepseek-v3 和 kimi-k2 的内置规则。请按实际权重与推理服务版本核对 YAML，再在目标硬件上测试启动与吞吐。
body.en: Built-in target rules include qwen3-27b, glm-4, deepseek-v3 and kimi-k2. Check the YAML against the actual weights and runtime version, then validate startup and throughput on the target hardware.

alt.zh: 模型目标包括 qwen3-27b、glm-4、deepseek-v3 和 kimi-k2 的内置规则。请按实际权重与推理服务版本核对 YAML，再在目标硬件上测试启动与吞吐。
alt.en: Built-in target rules include qwen3-27b, glm-4, deepseek-v3 and kimi-k2. Check the YAML against the actual weights and runtime version, then validate startup and throughput on the target hardware.

body.zh: 没有 token 运行或自动调优，仍需实际部署测试。
body.en: No tokens or autotuning are run; deployment testing remains necessary.

note.zh: 实际读取模型注册表，并将 8 核、64 GiB RAM、无 GPU 的构造输入送进真实合成函数。输出是静态估算，不是运行验证或最优参数。
note.en: The run reads the model registry and sends a constructed eight-core, 64 GiB RAM, CPU-only profile through the real synthesizer. The output is a static estimate, not a tested or optimal configuration.

body.zh: 列出本地注册表及默认 context 和 quant。
body.en: List the local targets with default context and quant.

steps.output:
qwen3-27b       Qwen3-27B               q=q4_k_m  ctx=8192  layers=64
deepseek-v3     DeepSeek-V3             q=q4_k_m  ctx=4096  layers=61
glm-4           GLM-4 (9B Chat)         q=q4_k_m  ctx=8192  layers=40
kimi-k2         Kimi-K2                 q=q4_k_m  ctx=4096  layers=61

body.zh: 从完整 CPU-only 输入生成参数与未执行的启动行。
body.en: Generate arguments and an unexecuted launch line from the complete CPU-only input.

body.zh: 需要 Go 1.24+。示例的硬件数据是显式 fixture，不探测本机，也不需要模型文件。
body.en: Requires Go 1.24+. The demo supplies an explicit hardware fixture, without probing this machine or reading model weights.

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/hwcfgmap.git
cd hwcfgmap
go build -o hwcfgmap ./cmd/hwcfgmap

limitations.zh: 参数由静态模型推导，不是实测最优解或部署成功保证。
limitations.en: Settings come from static rules, not measured optima or deployment guarantees.

limitations.zh: 本示例没有验证 GPU、国产卡 backend 或多卡拓扑。
limitations.en: This example does not validate GPU backends, domestic cards or multi-device topology.

limitations.zh: NVMe 字节计数不是吞吐率。
limitations.en: NVMe byte counters are not throughput rates.
